text:
The session-feed proposal is clear, so I made no changes and logged one "clear" line in `.claude/skills/clarity/flags.jsonl`.

`requirements.md` states the ask in the owner's words, lists the build steps and the head-line wording, and names the checks to run before landing. It is written for agents rather than the owner, so the ten-second and outcome tests don't apply to it.

`node Server/text-check.mjs` flagged only `past-work.md`, which is 928 words of prose against a 500-word limit. That file is generated by `Server/PastWork.mjs` and marked "do not hand-edit", and the owner doesn't read it. I left it alone.
